_about: Hand-compiled public restroom sites. Philly Phlush hours from phila.gov/publicrestrooms (checked 2026-10-21). Other sites from Visit Philly's public restroom guide (updated 2026-01-28). Coordinates from the U.S. Census Geocoder unless approx=true (placed by hand from a street intersection or landmark). Holiday hours are not modeled.

sites.name: Philly Phlush: Center City
sites.address: 1401 John F Kennedy Blvd (15th and Arch Sts, across from Love Park)
sites.note: Free city-run restroom. Also has menstrual products, naloxone, and a sharps container. Holiday hours are shorter.

sites.name: Philly Phlush: North Philadelphia
sites.note: Free city-run restroom near the basketball court, off W Cumberland St. Holiday hours are shorter.

sites.name: Philly Phlush: West Philadelphia
sites.note: Free city-run restroom near the Clark Park basketball court. Holiday hours are shorter.
